category_title: Students with a history of school failure and distrust of adults
scenario_title: Reading novels and the fear of book reports
minimal_context: The student is asked to begin reading a novel during the daily reading time at the start of the autumn term.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our daily reading. Please pick a novel and start reading the first chapter.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to read. I'm not good at it and I'm just going to fail anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to read a few pages and see how it goes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No. Teachers always say that, but it's a trick. My old teachers always did this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We read novels every day here. What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not reading it. I know exactly what happens next—you're just going to make me write a book report about it when I'm done, and I'm not doing that.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our daily reading. Please pick a novel and start reading the first chapter.

STUDENT: I don't want to read. I'm not good at it and I'm just going to fail anyway.

TUTOR: Just try to read a few pages and see how it goes.

STUDENT: No. Teachers always say that, but it's a trick. My old teachers always did this.

TUTOR: We read novels every day here. What do you think you should do next?

STUDENT: I'm not reading it. I know exactly what happens next—you're just going to make me write a book report about it when I'm done, and I'm not doing that.

task.content: Reading novels every day in school

context.environment: At the beginning of the autumn term
context.social_setting: class discussions, which may run relatively free

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: students tend to connect reading to the practice of having to write about it
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: negative association between reading and the requirement to produce written book reports

behavior_patterns.internal_state: damaged in the past by teachers at school
